title: Mirabel and the Spire Revisited
author: L. M. Ishikawa
blurb: Ansel Underhill, the keeper of a gate that should stay shut, has never left the valley where magic cannot follow. But when tonight's date appears in a book of prophecies written a century ago, she discovers that staying invisible was never really an option. Now she must unbind a king from the thing wearing his crown, and time is already running out.
style: warm, character-driven storytelling with gentle humor
